about_the_game:
Wouldn't it be even more captivating to experience the charming and mysterious tales of witches through a fully composed soundtrack?

Crimsona, who previously worked on Team Tapas’ Bistro Heroes and A Girl Adrift, brings the dreamlike world of Garden of Witches to life with an even higher-quality soundtrack.

Discover the original soundtrack crafted to match the game’s diverse regional themes, colorful witches, and dreamlike story!

Beyond Early Access, more tracks will be added as the full release and future development progress.
